title: Unveiling the Werner-Type Cluster Chemistry of Heterometallic 4f/Post-Transition Metals: A {Dy3Bi8} Complex Exhibiting Quantum Tunneling Steps in the Hysteresis Loops and its 1-D Congener

material_class.structural_family: Werner-type {Dy3Bi8} cluster with an elongated trigonal-bipyramidal {Bi8} unit surrounding a {Dy3} equilateral triangle

synthesis.procedure: Under aerobic conditions, solids BiCl3 (0.06 g, 0.20 mmol) and DyCl3·6H2O (0.08 g, 0.20 mmol) were added simultaneously to a stirred orange solution of saphH (0.04 g, 0.20 mmol) and NEt3 (28 μL, 0.20 mmol) in MeOH/MeCN (15 mL, 2:1 v/v). The orange suspension was stirred for 40 min until the solids dissolved, then filtered. Slow evaporation of the filtrate at room temperature afforded X-ray quality yellow platelike crystals of 1 after 4 days. The crystals were collected by filtration, washed with cold MeOH (2 × 2 mL) and Et2O (2 × 5 mL), and dried in air for 24 h. Yield 45% based on saphH.
synthesis.time: stirred 40 min; crystals after 4 days; dried in air 24 h
synthesis.vessel_or_method: aerobic solution synthesis with filtration and slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtration; slow evaporation at room temperature; yellow platelike crystals collected by filtration, washed with cold MeOH (2 × 2 mL) and Et2O (2 × 5 mL), dried in air 24 h

properties.summary: dc susceptibility of microcrystalline 1 shows χMT = 41.97 cm3 K mol−1 at room temperature (theory 42.51 for three uncoupled DyIII), remaining nearly constant to ~170 K then falling to 22.79 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K, consistent with crystal-field depopulation and weak intramolecular antiferromagnetic Dy···Dy coupling. Magnetization at 1.9–5 K rises without saturating at 7 T (~15.3 NμB vs 30 NμB expected), indicating anisotropy and a nontoroidal {Dy3} ground state. ac susceptibility (3.0 G ac) shows a frequency-dependent χM″ tail below ~9 K at zero dc field and still only tails under an optimum 600 Oe dc field, indicating slow relaxation/SMM-like behavior with residual QTM. Single-crystal μ-SQUID hysteresis (30 mK–5 K) exhibits rare two-step loops with steps at 0 and ±0.26 T that vanish above ~300 mK and are nearly sweep-rate independent at 30 mK; JIsing ≈ −4.86 cm−1 and JLines ≈ −0.19 cm−1.

material_class.structural_family: 1-D zigzag coordination polymer of {Dy3Bi8} cluster nodes linked by end-to-end azide bridges

synthesis.procedure: Method A: Me3SiN3 (54 μL, 0.40 mmol) was added dropwise over 20 min to a stirred yellow suspension of microcrystalline 1 (0.43 g, 0.10 mmol) in MeCN/THF (15 mL, 1:2 v/v). After dissolution, the yellow solution was filtered and the filtrate evaporated slowly at room temperature. After 3 days, yellow plate-like crystals of 2 were collected, washed with cold MeCN (2 × 2 mL) and Et2O (2 × 5 mL), and dried in air 24 h (yield 20% based on 1). Method B (direct): Me3SiN3 (108 μL, 0.80 mmol) was added to a stirred orange solution of saphH (0.04 g, 0.20 mmol) and NEt3 (28 μL, 0.20 mmol) in MeOH/MeCN (15 mL, 2:1 v/v), then BiCl3 (0.06 g, 0.20 mmol) and DyCl3·6H2O (0.08 g, 0.20 mmol) were added simultaneously. After 40 min stirring, filtration, and slow evaporation, crystals of 2 appeared after 5 days (yield 52% based on saphH).
synthesis.time: Method A: 20 min addition, crystals after 3 days; Method B: stirred 40 min, crystals after 5 days; dried in air 24 h
synthesis.vessel_or_method: aerobic solution synthesis; Method A metathesis of 1; Method B one-pot; filtration and slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtration; slow evaporation; yellow plate-like crystals washed with cold MeCN or MeOH and Et2O, dried in air 24 h
synthesis.yield: Method A 20% (based on 1); Method B 52% (based on saphH)

properties.summary: The magnetic properties of 2 are described as similar to molecular cluster 1 because the {Dy3Bi8} cores are chemically the same; detailed plots for 2 are given in Supporting Information Figures S8 and S9 rather than numerically in the main text.
